notes.title: Update Notes Playtest Version 1.0.6
notes.content: [p][b]Update Notes Playtest Version 1.0.6[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The following new selectable option is now available based on a community suggestion.[/p][p][/p][p][u]UI / Gamesettings:[/u][/p][list][*][p]Added a new selectable option for Crosshair:: " None+Hitindicator "[/p][/*][/list][p](If you want to play without an visible crosshair, you can now see, in case you missed the target, how far away the last shoot was)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45695796/73df7338cf405b162068eaa31d143ef431c8d1a5.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update Notes Playtest v. 1.0.5
notes.content:
[p][b]Update Notes Playtest v. 1.0.5[/b]

[b][u]Fixes::[/u][/b]

System message "ray tracing geometry over budget" should not apear any longer


[b][u]Changes::[/u][/b]

[u]Weapons balancing::[/u]
Rifle -> Damage increased, Ammo increased (+1 Bullet), Reload speed slightly increased

[u]Enemies:[/u]
Size increased (available as selectable option: Arcade/Standard)

[u]UI / Gamesettings:[/u]
Added selectable option within Gamesettings menu. Arcade and Standart sized enemies.
(As this is experimental at the moment, it only effects Level 1 for testing purposes first)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45695796/08567f6c87d0bcc27af3ddd3ae2a9770bbfb78ab.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #1 Playtest v. 1.0.4
notes.content: [p]Hey Everyone,[/p][p align="start"]Hotfix #1 is out for the current Playtest v. 1.0.4[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Fixed:[/p][p align="start"]- Graveyard level: Common Zombie enemies are now stopping as intended after taking damage.[/p]

notes.title: Update Notes Playtest v. 1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]Whats new?[/b]
[list]
[*] New graveyard level added
[*] Difficulty selection (Normal/Hard) is now activated
[*] Challenges are now activated
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes::[/b]
Automatic weapon do not longer keep shooting after pressing "continue"

[b]Notes::[/b]
Most of the used enemies are archetypes, variety will be increased in later versions.
The Challenges are different for each difficulty.
